mask_transfer.evaluation: same 32 WikiText test documents as first pilot, 512 tokens each
mask_transfer.primary_comparison: FP8 BF16-clean mask transfer versus FP8-clean top-m and random-m; identical m per token/layer and FP8-clean expert indices and router weights frozen
mask_transfer.secondary: adaptive top-320 and static clean top-320 for both precisions
mask_transfer.coverage: BF16-selected neurons in unrouted FP8 experts cannot be retained; report coverage explicitly

detection.firing_threshold: 97th percentile of signed router-weighted activation among routed calibration tokens, per precision
detection.negative_threshold: below 90th percentile, routed to same expert
detection.blinding: only released descriptions and passage pairs; precision, pole IDs, activation values and answer key withheld
detection.marking: 60 preceding tokens, focal token [TARGET], 8 following tokens
detection.duplicate_pairs: identical description and text pairs judged once and reused
limitations: English Wikipedia covers only part of the released description domains.
Percentiles calibrated on our small corpus differ from original 10B-token corpus.
Overlap of our public texts with original author discovery corpus is unknown.
Luna replaces the paper judge; absolute accuracy is not a direct reproduction of the headline 95%.
